title: Efficient isolation of interstitial fibroblasts directly from mouse kidneys or indirectly after ex vivo expansion
protocol: Harvest a mouse kidney.
Remove the fibrous capsule and renal medulla using forceps.
Mince the kidney with scissors until it becomes a smooth paste.
Wash minced kidneys with PBS in a C-tube three times, removing clear supernatant after 1 minute of standing.
Collect kidney pieces on a 70-μm strainer.
Wash remnants on the 70-μm strainer by face-down washing with DMEM containing FBS.
Mince a kidney with scissors on a Petri dish at room temperature.
Add 5 mL of ice-cold PBS to the minced kidney and transfer it into a C-tube.
Remove the supernatant (PBS) after 1 minute of standing on ice.
Gently mix the minced kidney with 5 mL of ice-cold PBS by pipetting.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 three times.
Resuspend the minced kidney with 5 mL of prewarmed Collagenase II solution.
Incubate the cell suspension for 1 hour at 37°C in a prewarmed shaking incubator.
Stir the cell suspension in a C-tube with a gentleMACS Dissociator (Program B: 553 rpm for 30 seconds) two times.
Centrifuge the mixture for 5 minutes at 4°C and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of DMEM containing FBS (10%, v/v).
Filter the cell suspension through a 70-μm cell strainer in a 50-mL tube.
Filter the cell suspension through a Preseparation filter.
Measure the cell concentration of the flow-through fraction.
Centrifuge the mixture at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in DMEM containing FBS (10%, v/v) at a concentration of approximately 1×10^6 cells/mL.
Store the resuspended cells on ice.
Incubate the cell suspension with antibodies (1:100 dilution) for 40 min on ice.
Wash the antibody-stained cells 3 times with DMEM containing FBS (10%, v/v).
Flip the 70-μm cell strainer over onto a dish to collect remnant cells on the strainer.
Flush the cell strainer with 6 mL of DMEM containing FBS.
Centrifuge the mixture for 5 min at 300×g and 4°C, then remove supernatant.
Resuspend kidney pieces in 6 mL of semisolid culture medium.
Seed kidney pieces on dishes or plates.
Incubate cells for 7–14 days at 37°C in a CO2 (5%) incubator.
Harvest cells by pipetting 10 times the PBS volume and place cells in a 50-mL tube.
Centrifuge mixture for 5 min at 300×g and 4°C, then discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge mixture for 5 min at 300×g and 4°C, then discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of Accutase.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 10 min.
Add 3 mL of DMEM containing FBS to the mixture.
Filter the cell suspension through a Preseparation filter (a 30-μm cell strainer) in a 15-mL tube.
Determine the cell concentration in the flow-through fraction.
Centrifuge the mixture at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend the cells in DMEM containing FBS at a concentration of approximately 1×10^6 cells/mL.
Store the resuspended cells on ice.
Stain the cells with antibodies.
Sort the cells according to steps 18 and 19.
